notes: Long songs and podcasts (1-2 hours) now play in the background

note: HOW TO RELEASE AN UPDATE: (1) changed anything inside android-app/ -> raise the android number by 1 AND bump DreamTuneApp/N in MainActivity.java. (2) changed only the website -> change the web text to anything new (e.g. today's date). (3) edit notes (max 5 lines). Then deploy. Everyone sees the Update popup; Skip hides it until the next version.
